title: Sign in the command line
question: Create the API token “<token/>” for <person/>?
effect: The command line on that computer can then do everything you can, for 90 days.
sent: The token is on its way to the command line. You can close this tab.

badLink.title: This sign-in link does not work
badLink.body: The link lakana login opened is incomplete or changed: its port must be between 1024 and 65535. Run lakana login again.

device.title: Sign in a command line elsewhere
device.intro: Type the code lakana login --device shows on the other computer.
device.unknown: No sign-in is waiting for this code. Check it on the other computer; it works for 10 minutes.
device.approved: Done. Go back to the terminal: lakana login finishes there.
device.denied: Refused. The command line on that computer was told, and no token was created.
device.warning: Continue only if you started lakana login --device yourself, a moment ago. Never enter a code someone sent you or read out to you: whoever started this sign-in would get a token that acts as you.
device.requestedNow: Requested from <address/>, less than a minute ago.

effectLinked: The command line on that computer can then do everything you can, for 90 days, and only while you keep signing in to Lakana through your identity provider.
warning: Continue only if you ran lakana login on this computer yourself, a moment ago. If a link or a message brought you here, close this tab.
